items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: They lived all for Louis, Roy Aldrich all of them.

ctx.x: Yeah. He didn't like bop music very much, did he? What do you mean bop? Well, you know the music that came along during the fifties that was...

Oh. He never tried to play that. Uh huh. Because he had his way of playing. And Louis, all them guys was playing bop, used to sit down and try to play Louis, dizzing all of them. Yeah. They lived all for Louis, Roy Aldrich all of them. I got records, I got everything they did, I don't care what they play on them, Louis Armstrong is in it. Yeah.
I guess he's really the father of all of you, isn't he? Father of the world.
